publicDocumentsReviewed.title: Terms of Service | FreeInference
publicDocumentsReviewed.appliesTo: FreeInference service route only, subject to account and applicability confirmation
observedRelevantText: The page describes an experimental research service with hosted/routed inference.

Prompts and responses may be logged, stored, hashed, redacted or processed; logs/derived data may be used to operate, secure, debug, improve and analyze the service; anonymized derived data may be published/open-sourced; sanitization is not guaranteed to remove all sensitive information.
The page instructs users not to submit sensitive personal/confidential/regulated data, secrets, credentials, or data they are not authorized to process.
Requests may be forwarded to third-party model providers under those providers’ terms.

publicDocumentsReviewed.title: Sandbox and security — FreeInference docs
observedRelevantText: Documentation says prompts/responses are logged for research; during beta, conversations, task events, and sandboxes are kept until permanent deletion; formal retention policy is planned.

publicDocumentsReviewed.title: Z.ai Terms of Use and Additional Terms for API Services
observedRelevantText: The page says enterprise/developer API users are also subject to API Additional Terms; those terms describe downstream integration rights and say API End User Content is used as needed to provide API services/comply with law/enforce policies/prevent abuse, with service improvement opt-in.
The API terms point to a Data Processing Addendum and permit limited necessary processing rights to subcontractors/sub-processors.
The API terms prohibit external-model training/optimization uses except authorized integration for specific business scenarios.
The page also says third-party model/API services are subject to the providers’ own terms.
publicDocumentsReviewed.applicabilityNote: Direct Z.ai platform/API terms are not evidence that these terms govern a FreeInference-routed request. Confirm exact upstream model/provider contract and route before relying on this document.
